title: Standalone testing does not close unrelated gates
when: When the user asks to run a saved plan now without an item or deployment-run subject.
need: A standalone plan execution freezes its own roster and owns its evidence. It changes no item transition or release acceptance; an unrelated green result is not substitute proof.
surface: Standalone plan run help/reference; plan detail outcome
gap: Review question: should QA Plans offer distinct explanatory routes for test now and require this for work, before the agent selects scope?
